summary: Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (version 1). The critic scored it 0.93 and found no concrete issues. It contains the points B, C, H, A, D, P, E, F, G, Q with solid lines BC, BA, CD, AD, AE, and dashed lines PA, PD, FG, GH, FH, EH, HQ, plus a right-angle mark at Q. No circles or arcs. The labels were read visually because bind_point_labels returned no bindings.
